description: Customer age field containing 30 records with no missing values and 24 distinct values. Value range spans -5 to 66. Data quality issues include: 1 non-numeric text value ('Twenty-five', 3.3% of records) and 2 implausible values (-5 and 4) that fall below typical age thresholds for service accounts.
recommended_actions: [STANDARDIZE] Convert text-based number to integer (3.3% of records): 'Twenty-five' → 25.
[CLARIFY] Verify validity of 2 age values (-5 and 4) that fall below 13 years; confirm if these represent data entry errors, test accounts, or minors with authorized access.
[VALIDATE] Ensure all values are non-negative integers within a reasonable age range (e.g., 0-120 years) after standardization.
